Compass is rebuilt from the ground up to be much lighter. It looks and works the same, and your settings, library and unfinished downloads carry over.

## New
- Much smaller download: the Linux `.deb` is about 4 MB instead of 100 MB, and the Windows installer shrinks too.
- The app opens faster.
- On Linux the `.deb` installs qBittorrent for you if it is missing.
- Your downloads now go to the Downloads folder in your own language (for example `~/İndirilenler/Torrent`) on new installs. Existing settings are kept.

## Install
- **Linux:** the `.deb` (recommended) or the `.AppImage`. With the `.AppImage`, install qBittorrent first: `sudo apt install qbittorrent-nox`.
- **Windows:** the `setup.exe`. Install [qBittorrent](https://www.qbittorrent.org/download) first.

Only download what you have the right to download.
